notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Molten Duplication
description:
Cast Molten Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Molten Duplication, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
